zin_shared_west_lands_pact_one = {
	set_temp_variable = { zin_pact_fewest = 1000 }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_pact_pick = 0 }
	every_neighbor_country = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = zin_region_west_lands
			NOT = { zin_shared_west_lands_is_gunwaith = yes }
			NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
			NOT = { has_non_aggression_pact_with = ROOT }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_pact_count = num_owned_states }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_pact_count < zin_pact_fewest } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_pact_fewest = zin_pact_count }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_pact_pick = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_pact_pick > 0 } }
		diplomatic_relation = {
			country = var:zin_pact_pick
			relation = non_aggression_pact
			active = yes
		}
	}
}

}

zin_shared_west_lands_seek_guarantee = {
	set_temp_variable = { zin_pick_most = 0 }
	every_other_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_region_west_lands
			NOT = { zin_shared_west_lands_is_gunwaith = yes }
			NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_pick_count = num_owned_states }

			limit = { check_variable = { zin_pick_count > zin_pick_most } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_pick_most = zin_pick_count }
			save_event_target_as = zin_west_guarantor
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_pick_most > 0 } }
		event_target:zin_west_guarantor = { country_event = zin_shared_west_lands.2 }
	}
}

# Arguments: zin_arg_who (country), zin_arg_modifier (1-based position in the opinion_modifiers block), zin_arg_both (1 for both ways).
zin_shared_west_lands_opinion = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_modifier = 1 }
		}
		var:zin_arg_who = {
			reverse_add_opinion_modifier = {
				target = PREV
				modifier = zin_shared_west_lands_council_league
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { zin_arg_both = 1 }
				}
				add_opinion_modifier = {
					target = PREV
					modifier = zin_shared_west_lands_council_league
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
